stem: Based on the information in paragraphs 1 through 4, what can the reader conclude about students who join a book club?

options.label: A
options.text: The students want to start a new book club.

options.label: B
options.text: The students belong to several book clubs.

options.label: C
options.text: The students develop good reading habits.

options.label: D
options.text: The students read more than their parents.
